- Paragraph 2 (Answer): Yes, I can explain the difference between quicksort and mergesort. Mergesort, on the other hand, is a stable, divide-and-conquer algorithm that divides the array in half, recursively sorts each half, and then merges the sorted halves. It has a guaranteed O(n log n) time complexity and requires O(n) extra space.
